verdict: Ads are running and converting, but tracking is broken and needs fixing.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Google Ads account recorded 11 conversions while your lead count shows zero — the conversions are real, but a disconnect between ad tracking and your intake system is hiding them from the report. Spend for the period was $1,062.10, with the Local Services campaign carrying the largest share at $639.06. Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply this past week, which we are monitoring closely heading into the fall season. Conversion tracking is being repaired now so next period's report will reflect actual lead volume accurately.
